title: Science Contradicts
summary: Placeholder framing for the response to claims that science and Christianity conflict. Replace with your own writing.

argument.conclusion: Science and Christian faith are not in conflict — properly understood, they are complementary ways of understanding reality.

premises.text: Modern science itself arose within a Christian intellectual context that expected the universe to be orderly and knowable.
Apparent conflicts between science and Christianity are usually conflicts with a particular interpretation, not with the faith itself.

objections.text: Hasn't evolution disproven the biblical account of human origins?
